product.title: Everglades National Park Biologist Led Adventure: Cruise, Hike + Airboat

description.text: Explore the real Everglades with a master naturalist on this full-day adventure. Enjoy a Ten Thousand Islands boat tour to spot birds, manatees, and dolphins; and a master-naturalist-led dry nature hike in Big Cypress National Preserve.
